name: academania
description: Academic Project & Research Services Platform — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @academania/frontend" "npm run start:dev -w @academania/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w @academania/backend && npm run build -w @academania/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @academania/frontend && npm run lint -w @academania/backend
